title: 30-Day Launch Roadmap Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Entrepreneurship
description: A step-through vis-timeline of Jordan's 30-day launch plan with four equal week blocks, each showing its weekly target, and a detail panel giving each week's plan, weekly milestone, weekly target, and the piece of launch readiness it adds.

educational.topic: Weekly milestones and targets in a 30-day launch plan
learningObjectives: Explain what each week of a 30-day launch roadmap accomplishes
Explain how weekly milestones and weekly targets build toward launch readiness, using Jordan's plan as a worked example

controls.label: Previous
controls.purpose: Step back one week (also the left arrow key)

controls.label: Next
controls.purpose: Step forward one week (also the right arrow key)

controls.label: Week blocks
controls.purpose: Click to jump to a week; hover for a one-line preview of its milestone

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Step-through timeline with concrete detail for each week, no animation
keyQuestions: What does each week of the plan add that the week before it did not?
How do the first three weeks supply what the Week 4 launch readiness check looks at?
commonMisconceptions: A 30-day plan is a rigid script rather than a set of checkpoints to evaluate against
A weekly milestone and a weekly target are the same thing
assessmentOpportunities: State what each of the four weeks accomplishes without looking
Explain the difference between a weekly milestone and a weekly target using one of Jordan's weeks
